ITA-5.76.14 aśuddharaktastambhanam अशुद्धरक्तस्तम्भनम्
Condition of hoaemostasis of vitiated blood
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: choking sensation in throat; pus discharge from the nose; syncope or swooning; loss of taste; fever; palpable glandular enlargement in abdomen/abdominal lump; enlargement of plīha; borborygmi with distension; a type of skin disease; dysuria; skin diseases; haemorrhoids; erysipelas; loss of complexion; anal fistula; inhibition of sense function; obstruction of sense organ functioning.

ITA-9.1.53 āśukāricikitsā आशुकारिचिकित्सा
Fast-acting treatment
A rapidly acting treatment such as therapeutic cautery.

ITA-2.8.20 āsurakāyaḥ आसुरकायः
Person with brave, cruel temperament
The characteristics of the person with a brave, cruel temperament are attaining prosperity, fearfulness or violence, courageousness, angriness, jealousy of others’ progress, eating alone and voraciously.
